notes: Requires the AutoFlow Supplier Foundation app. See docs/apps/SupplierFoundation.md.
Offered in the step picker for every trigger.

Fire and forget: queues every flow published on ItemUpdate (5564014) for the record, with the outputs the page action 'Update from supplier' would give them, each as its own execution with a Job Queue entry. The calling flow continues at once and never learns how the runs end.
The calling flow itself is never queued (so a flow on that trigger cannot start itself over and over). Two flows that start each other's triggers are not guarded.

Business Central starts a Job Queue entry only after the transaction that created it commits. In a background flow that is the end of this step; in an inline or synchronous flow it is the end of the caller's transaction, and if that transaction rolls back, nothing is started.
Logs an Info entry '%1 flow(s) started for %2.'
Flows on this trigger otherwise run inline; started by this step they run queued (commit per step, no timeout). Write them so both work.
